original.target_description: Study 1 located in full. Original PDF p. 5 (journal p. 97) includes between-condition estimated-intake tests for ounces and calories and discussion of within-self-refilling-condition actual-versus-estimated calorie correlations; description does not uniquely identify which test or unit is intended.

replication.target_description: Study 1 located in full. Replication advance-online p. 4 Table 1 includes separate between-condition estimated-ounce and estimated-calorie tests; actual-versus-estimated within-condition correlations are instead in Table 2 on p. 5. Supplied description does not distinguish these tests.

reported_success.location: Advance-online paper p. 5, Discussion; cached HTML L856
reported_success.quote: We therefore deem this replication successful.

notes: Both full primary papers were obtained and their titles matched. The neutral description concerns actual versus estimated intake among self-refilling-bowl participants, while the replication page locator points to between-condition comparisons. Selecting either ounces or calories, or a between-condition rather than within-condition test, would require an unsupported choice. Both sides therefore retain null statistic fields with locator_insufficient rather than assigning a statistic from an unverified test. Reported success records only the explicit overall author verdict; it is not an effect-specific verdict.
